## About

COSIC provides nationwide Transportation, Logistics, Warehousing & Distribution Services.

COSIC: 125-truck operation providing full truckload Dry Van, Hot Shot, Liftgate, LTL, and Last-Mile transportation service nationwide plus Mexico and Canada. SmartWay Transport Partner.
